decision: The proposed explicit addition of lambda*Tr(WP) to spectral ETOT/F was rejected before outcomes because the prescribed spectral energy is ETOT_spectral and the operator enters through the Hamiltonian/eigenvalues and band/radial energy path; an extra explicit term could double count. Preserve physical_total_energy and the original spectral diagnostic formula. The transient source edit was reverted exactly to the v1 self.f90 hash.
measurement_status: No A4.1 lambda SCF or response outcome was run with the transient source or binary.
